summary: Aduro Clean Technologies filed a Form 6-K reporting a US$15.64 million underwritten public offering and a concurrent US$7.17 million private placement (LIFE Offering) of common shares at US$15.20 per share. Canaccord Genuity is sole bookrunner; aggregate gross proceeds up to US$22.8 million. Net proceeds will fund a demonstration-scale plant, R&D, and working capital. The filing is a routine capital raise under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation.
